title: A session registers as a holder and gets its own credential

story.as_a: Claude Code session on a fleet machine
story.i_want_to: register as a holder when I start and get a server-minted credential bound to my session, host and worktree
story.so_that: I act in my own name and loopctl can tell me apart from every other session that shares my agent

rationale: Every fleet session authenticates with one shared agent key (LOOPCTL_AGENT_KEY, mcp-server/index.js:530), so loopctl cannot tell two sessions apart (PRD section 1, loopctl#707). PRD R3 makes each session its own holder with a server-minted identity, and section 4 keeps agents as the account that holds keys, with per-session holders hanging off it. Today one agent can hold only one live key per role (api_keys_one_role_per_agent_idx, priv/repo/migrations/20260411233503_enforce_api_key_invariants.exs:43-46), so a second session of one agent cannot even get a credential.

acceptance_criteria.description: A holders table (schema Loopctl.Holders.Holder, context Loopctl.Holders) stores tenant_id, agent_id, kind (runner_session | interactive | cloud), session_id, host, worktree, dispatch_id (nullable), last_seen_at, lease_until, ended_at and ended_reason (ended | lapsed), with RLS enabled and a partial unique index holders_live_session_uidx on (tenant_id, agent_id, session_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL.

api_keys gains a nullable holder_id (FK holders, ON DELETE RESTRICT, never cast); api_keys_one_role_per_agent_idx is rebuilt with the extra predicate holder_id IS NULL, and a new partial unique index api_keys_one_live_key_per_holder_idx on (holder_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND holder_id IS NOT NULL keeps one live credential per holder.

POST /api/v1/holders (role: :agent, RequireHumanAnchor) with {kind: interactive, session_id, host, worktree} from an unlineaged key carrying an agent_id creates the holder and mints an :agent api key with the caller's agent_id and the holder's holder_id, expiring when the holder's lease_until does plus one renewal (Loopctl.Holders.credential_ttl_seconds/0), answering 201 {holder, credential} with the raw key once.

A register retried with the same (agent_id, session_id) while that holder is live returns 200 with the same holder id and a new credential, revoking the previous credential in the same transaction (the caller never saw it), so a lost response never leaves two holders for one session.

A caller whose key already carries a holder_id gets 200 with that holder and no credential (credential: null); a caller with a dispatch lineage and no holder_id is refused by RequireUnlineagedCaller with 403 code holder_mint_forbidden; a key with no agent_id is refused 422 agent_required.

POST /api/v1/holders/:id/heartbeat by that holder's own credential sets last_seen_at = now and lease_until = now + Loopctl.Holders.lease_seconds/0, moves its credential's expires_at to the new lease_until plus one heartbeat interval, and answers {lease_until, heartbeat_seconds}; any other caller gets 404 (no existence oracle), and an ended holder gets 409 holder_ended.

POST /api/v1/holders/:id/end by that holder's own credential sets ended_at and revokes its credential through Auth.revoke_api_key/1 (cluster cache invalidated) in one transaction; a repeated end answers 200 with the ended holder and writes nothing.

The MCP server calls holder_register at startup with kind interactive, CLAUDE_SESSION_ID (a generated uuid when unset), os.hostname() and the git top level of process.cwd(), sends every LOOPCTL_AGENT_KEY request with the holder credential instead, heartbeats every heartbeat_seconds on a timer, and calls holder_end on stdin close or SIGTERM; MCP tools holder_register, holder_heartbeat and holder_end exist with README rows.

test_cases.name: holders schema, isolation and the live-session index (DataCase)
preconditions: two tenants; agent = fixture(:agent) in tenant A
expected_results: second live insert for s1 is not a new row; after end a new row is allowed; tenant B gets {:error, :not_found}

test_cases.name: two holders of one agent each hold a live :agent key (DataCase)
preconditions: agent with a live plain :agent key
steps: register holder H1 and H2 for that agent
insert a second plain :agent key for the agent
insert a second live key for H1 through AdminRepo
expected_results: H1 and H2 credentials both live; the plain duplicate still fails api_keys_one_role_per_agent_idx; the H1 duplicate fails api_keys_one_live_key_per_holder_idx

test_cases.name: register route: mint, holder-bound caller, lineaged caller, agentless key (ConnCase)
preconditions: human-anchored tenant; plain agent key; a dispatch-minted agent key; a holder credential; a user key with no agent_id
expected_results: 201 with credential; 200 credential null; 403 holder_mint_forbidden; 422 agent_required

test_cases.name: a retried register rotates the credential of the same holder (DataCase)
preconditions: holder H registered for session s1 with credential K1
expected_results: same holder id, new raw key K2; K1 refused as revoked

test_cases.name: heartbeat and end by owner, stranger and after end (ConnCase)
expected_results: 200 with a later lease_until; 404; 200 then 200 with no second audit row; 401 (credential revoked)

test_cases.name: MCP holder lifecycle and key substitution
expected_results: POST /api/v1/holders first; claim sent with the holder credential; one heartbeat POST; one end POST; holder tools declared and dispatched (node --test)

technical_notes: Why a new table: agents (lib/loopctl/agents/agent.ex:44-50) is the account that owns keys and anchors KB vote collapse (lib/loopctl/knowledge.ex:11923-11931), so one row per session would break both; a dispatch (lib/loopctl/dispatches/dispatch.ex:17-36) has no session, host, worktree or liveness, and an interactive session cannot mint one (root dispatch is operator-only, lib/loopctl_web/plugs/require_unlineaged_caller.ex:26-30). PRD section 4 row 'agents'.

The credential is a plain api_keys row (lib/loopctl/auth/api_key.ex:34-44): an unlineaged agent key minting an unlineaged key of its own agent and role crosses no lineage ceiling (require_unlineaged_caller.ex:26) and gains no role. Mint through Auth.generate_api_key/2 (lib/loopctl/auth.ex:56) with holder_id set programmatically; revoke through Auth.revoke_api_key/1 (:252), which invalidates the cluster cache (:264). A heartbeat that moves expires_at invalidates the same cache entry (ApiKeyCache.invalidate_cluster/1), or a cached copy would expire the credential early.

api_key.ex:94-97 unique_constraint names api_keys_one_role_per_agent_idx; add a second unique_constraint for api_keys_one_live_key_per_holder_idx. The predicate cannot test expiry (lib/loopctl/delivery/placement.ex:982-987), which is why the holder index keys on revoked_at and end always revokes.

RequireUnlineagedCaller (require_unlineaged_caller.ex:68) takes :code/:message/:remedy; mount it with code holder_mint_forbidden after the holder-bound short-circuit in the controller's own plug order, remedy: 'runner sessions are holders already; use the key your dispatch gave you'.

Loopctl.Holders.lease_seconds/0 and heartbeat_seconds/0 read HOLDER_LEASE_SECONDS / HOLDER_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS with defaults 300 and 60 here; US-52.19 measures and sets them. Both get FLY_SECRETS.md rows (CLAUDE.md, Doc hygiene).

MCP: resolveKey (mcp-server/index.js:186) stays; add agentKey() returning the holder credential once registered, else LOOPCTL_AGENT_KEY, and replace each process.env.LOOPCTL_AGENT_KEY argument with it. CLAUDE_SESSION_ID in the MCP process env is assumed from the harness's use of ${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}; the generated-uuid fallback keeps registration working if it is absent.
Audit: register, rotate and end each write an audit_log row (entity_type holder) through Audit.log_in_multi in the same transaction, actor = the calling key.

Routes under the authenticated /api/v1 scope (lib/loopctl_web/router.ex:245); each operation/2 lists 403 holder_mint_forbidden, 404, 409 holder_ended, 422 agent_required; CHANGELOG.md entry for the new API and the index change.
non_goals: Holder ids on claims and the second-claim refusal: US-52.14.
Measuring and setting the lease, and holder claims following the holder's lease: US-52.19.
Writing the credential to $HOME/.claude/loopctl-holders/<session_id>.key (mode 0600) for the session's hooks: US-52.28 (release 4); no release-3 hook calls loopctl as the holder.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.13.6: a holder cut off stops heartbeating, its lease_until passes and it is no longer live; on reconnect it re-registers (AC-52.13.4) and keeps its holder id.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.13.1: the holder lives in the holders row and its credential in api_keys; the MCP process keeps a copy of the raw key (in memory in this release; US-52.28 also writes it to a 0600 file for the session's hooks), and a restart re-registers by session_id.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.13.4: a retried register for a live (agent_id, session_id) rotates the credential of the one holder, held to one row by holders_live_session_uidx and one live key by api_keys_one_live_key_per_holder_idx (AC-52.13.2); a repeated end writes nothing (AC-52.13.7).
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.13.6: the lease is several heartbeats long, so one slow or lost heartbeat does not end the holder; each call is one indexed write.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.13.8: the holder is reached through loopctl by its holder id and credential; the MCP process on the session's machine is the only thing that heartbeats it.

defaults: HOLDER_LEASE_SECONDS 300 and HOLDER_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS 60 until US-52.19 sets measured values.
Credential lifetime: lease_until plus one heartbeat interval, extended on each heartbeat.
A lineaged caller without a holder is refused, never given a holder: runner sessions register through the socket (US-52.15).
definition_of_done: From a fresh Claude Code session on minis, SELECT kind, host, session_id FROM holders WHERE ended_at IS NULL shows one interactive row for that session, and a second session in another worktree adds a second row with the same agent_id.
Closing the session sets ended_at on its row and revoked_at on its api_keys row.
